t: Report to Kirill Sechin upon completion of quests Reconnaissance on the Overcharged Shore, Swampscale and Extra Trolls.

The next three important quests are as follows: Reconnaissance on the Overcharged Shore, Swampscale and Extra Trolls.
I must admit that I am very satisfied with these developments. Everything is going according to plan! And that's important.
Did you complete the quests from the third phase?

Wow! Never before have we been so close to victory!
And why?
Because we stick to the plan!

secrets: The Battle for the Holy Land

t: Take the Sites of Power near Misty Slope, in Texio Swamp, in Tekyan Thicket, and near the June Stronghold and report to Colonel Braid the Bloodthirsty.

As I have already mentioned, there are many Sites of Power in Asee-Teph. We keep battling the League for them, and the Sites keep passing from our hands to theirs. One day we hope to capture all of them for ourselves, and then we will receive the ultimate Gift of Asee-Teph!
Most of the southern Sites of Power should already be in our control since they're so close to our main camp. The bloodiest battles are for the Sites located in the center of Asee-Teph.
Those are the front lines, and that's where I'm going to send you off to. Here, take this! This banner will help you bring a Site of Power under the control of the Empire. Once the Site becomes ours, you will gain a special blessing that will make you stronger, or more intelligent, and so on. Every Site of Power grants its own gift.
I order you to capture the disputed Sites of Power and return to me. Maybe then you can try and capture the League sites to the north at your own risk.
Wonderful! The disputed Sites of Power are now ours! Soon the League will be left with nothing!
Go to the Isle of the Dead and defeat Genoer the Devourer. If you succeed, report your success to Kirill Sechin.

Quickly, come here. I have a very important matter to tell you about.
The Demon Hunters recently discovered a small allod not far from the Holy Land. They named it the "Isle of the Dead". Out of the entire expedition that first found the allod, only one survived.
He told his comrades of a certain monster that lives on the allod. From his descriptions, it sounds like we're dealing with another one of Tep's monsters. It's a deadly combination of necromancy and mechanics.
We also learned that the monster feeds on souls, just like some of Tep's other creations. As it devours more and more, it becomes stronger and stronger.
You have a new mission - to defeat this horrible creature. Of course you won't be able to do that alone. I don't think anybody could manage that, not even Yasker. In order to succeed you must gather a team of your most trusted comrades.
To get to the Isle of the Dead you can take the ship that leaves from the eastern pier. It was specially commissioned just so that elite soldiers like you could take care of this menace. When you kill the devourer return to me for a reward.
It sounds like this is one of Tep's most advanced creations. Only an army could take it down.

The monster is slain? Well done! I always knew you could do it. I hope Tep learns of what you accomplished. It should strike fear into even him.
Here's your reward, as promised. And I shall be sure to tell my superiors. Your deed shall be praised by the entire Empire!
Find the 6 Stones of Asee-Teph and report back to anthropologist Evgeny Susanin.

To be able to call yourself a true scholar, you must be very aware of your surroundings.
As a test, I have placed six stones imbued with magic around Asee-Teph. Explore this great jungle, find the stones and report back to me.
Only after you have done this will I agree to take you under my wing. You can find these stones in the Tekyan Thicket, Kotick the Dead City, June Stronghold, Texio Swamp, and of course, Tensess' Temple. Good luck, traveler.
What are you waiting for? You'll never learn more if you can't follow instructions.
Great! You're on your way to becoming a great anthropologist yourself!
Collect 6 Asee-Teph Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Evgeny Susanin.

Hey, I know you're a seasoned traveler and all, but Asee-Teph is a very dangerous place!
You let your guard down for one second and that's it! It's all over! I want you to get used to the dangers of a place like this, so I need you to venture out and kill six of Asee-Teph's most dangerous creatures!
But you need to give me proof – a trophy from the likes of K'tah, Bloodleaf, Grimetooth, a bloodthirsty jungle tiger, a vicious swamp crocodile, an experienced lamia fighter, a ravenous tropical manticore, a vicious mottled tapir, an elder leafy gar... And so on and so forth...
Well? Have those creatures been defeated?

Excellent!
I knew you could do it. And by defeating these beasts, you now know more about the local fauna.
Kill 100 carnivorous animals and report back to anthropologist Evgeny Susanin.

Asee-Teph is a savage land. Jungles are flooded with annoying insects, deadly snakes and huge tigers growling around the camp at nights. Horrible manticores are guarding their territory, crossing the invisible border would be fatal for an unlucky adventurer. These beasts are worse than the League... I wish we could sign a peace treaty with crocodiles!
I'm so tired of living in danger. Kill at least a hundred of carnivorous animals - hydras, tigers, manticores, crocodiles, boars, cobras, hyenas... Let's make the jungle a safer place.
Jungle is a much safer place now, right?
Thank you! We can all sleep more soundly tonight.
Collect 7 pieces of Kurae Rind and report back to anthropologist Evgeny Susanin.

There are a lot of resources that can be found in a jungle such as this.
But we're only interested in one thing. There are trees here that are very valuable to us. I bet you'll never guess what it can do. A very special poison can be made from its rind. It's incredibly deadly and we call it kurae.
It's incredibly useful for us here in Asee-Teph! Please go gather some for us!
You can find the trees all over Asee-Teph! Just look harder!
Great! This is sure to teach the League a lesson!
Complete all of the Anthropologist's tasks and report back to Evgeny Susanin.

If you can successfully complete all my tasks, you'll be generously rewarded.
And I'm not talking about some rinky-dink potion! You'll have the knowledge that you've gained from this adventure as well as some prime equipment that's bound to help you on your future journeys!
So, find the stones, defeat the beasts, and gather some valuable resources here in Asee-Teph!
Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Collect 6 Asee-Teph Trophies from the most dangerous creatures and return to Anthropologist Vladimir Sahnov.

Have you completed all of my tasks?

Wonderful!
You know, I must admit, I didn't think you'd be able to do it. Thank you for proving me wrong! Go ahead and take your reward!
Kill 6 Poisonous Slugs on the border between Asee-Teph and Eljune. Report back to Bugailo the Unyielding in the Central Imperial Camp.

Alarming news has come in from the west!
It seems like Eljune is seeing a strange migration of creatures to Asee-Teph! These parasitic slugs are the extremely dangerous! Not only are do they excrete poison, but they eat everything along the way! If these menaces aren't stopped, they'll turn our lush jungles into empty plains! And do we really need another Coba Plateau?
I need you to go to the western border and kill these slugs!
The more dead slugs I see, the better!

Ha! Great work!
Be sure to check back often. We don't know how fast these slugs can multiply.
Kill 6 Poisonous Slugs on the border between Asee-Teph and Eljune. Report back to Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp.

Alarming news has come in from the west!
It seems like Eljune is seeing a strange migration of creatures to Asee-Teph! These parasitic slugs are the extremely dangerous! Not only are do they excrete poison, but they eat everything along the way! If these menaces aren't stopped, they'll turn our lush jungles into empty plains! And do we really need another Coba Plateau? ...Ugh.
I need you to go to the western border and kill these slugs!
Kill those nasty things in any way possible!

Ew...
Your weapons are covered in slime. Great job, but go wash that off.
Kill 6 Regal Cobras on the border between Asee-Teph and the Coba Plateau. Report back to Bugailo the Unyielding in the Central Imperial Camp.

Have you seen a cobra before? I'm not talking about in pictures or anything... But in person. There's something about them. They way they move, the patterns on their scales... It's all very majestic.
Bah! But I'm sure that's not for you, right?!
Ha-ha! That's why I picked you to go kill them! We need someone who can go get the job done!
How are things on the eastern border? Are those beautiful creatures dead?
Ha-ha! I knew you had it in you!
Kill 6 Regal Cobras on the border between Asee-Teph and the Coba Plateau. Report back to Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp.

Do you like snakes? I think they're gross.
I mean, have you ever touched one? Uhh. The thought of it makes me shudder.
That's why you're a good fit for this job! Nothing ever seems to faze you! There has been a great surge in the cobra population on the eastern border. I want you to get over there and thin them out a bit.
Oh, stop complaining and just do it.
Ha-ha. What? You aren't telling me that you're afraid of snakes, are you?
See? I knew you could do it.
Meet Vlada Merinova, Nezeb Committee agent.

Where have you been? Busy ambushing League soldiers? Ha ha...
Good cause, though. But there is another task for you, much more important. Vlada Merinova will fill you in.
I've been looking for you. So glad you are here!

When you raise your Flag of War you will then be able to attack members of the League. However, they will also be able to attack you. If you decide not to partake in the hostilities, simply refrain from attacking League soldiers for a 5 minutes, and your Flag will lower.
You also should know that when your Flag of War is raised here in the Holy Land your experience gain will increase by 10%. I strongly recommend that you aid the Empire and eradicate the League menace!
h: Ask about the Flag of War

t: Sneak into the Historians' camp, collect the Containers of Dark Artifacts, and bring them to Klavdius Trojanov.

So, the Historians' goblins are in possession of some dark artifacts... Truth be told, that's the last thing I would have expected from the Historians!
We must act at once! We must take drastic measures! For instance, we'll head to the Historians' Camp and capture those containers of artifacts by force. Yes, by force! The time for diplomacy is over!
Especially with the Empire breathing down our neck. I'm sure they know everything already and are scheming another nasty prank, so you better watch your back!
I'm beside myself! What's going on with those artifacts?
Aha! The containers full of artifacts are ours and that Empire has nothing! The League has prevailed!
Meet Gorislav Kovchegov, Priest of the Church of Light.

Thank the great Tensess, I found you.
One of Tensess' servants is looking for you. His name is Gorislav Kovchegov, and his matter is very urgent.
Right on time! I've been out trying to find you. I understand you are a busy adventurer, but this assignment is of utmost importance.
Kill Krut the Tormentor, take his Mysterious Key, and relay the information to Klavdius Trojanov.

Praise Tensess! Finally someone to share this load with! The unimaginable has happened! Recently Chairman Vissarion Arhivin arrived at the camp, and vanished just as quickly. Apparently he went into the heart of the Temple, meaning he must know how to get through the magical barrier!
But that's not all. He left a goblin in charge of the camp, without so much as talking to me first! Now Krut the Tormentor is running things. This camp has become our prison and he our jailer! He has forbid the Historians from leaving the camp! Oh, the injustice!
I fear that there is only one explanation for this - Chairman Arhivin has been bought by the demon worshippers! The Historians have been lied to! Our good name is soiled!
But the most recent crisis is that Krut is planning to deliver a batch of the Dark Artifacts into the Temple! That means he must also know how to get through the barrier. Perhaps he even has something like a key...
You must search him and then inform someone of this crisis. The Empire or the League - it doesn't matter who! Just put an end to Arhivin's schemes and clear the Historians' good name!

So you're telling me that Chairman Arhivin was siding with a hidden enemy all this time and nobody noticed anything?! Vile traitor! May he be swallowed up by the darkness! Those poor Historians. I really wouldn't want to be in their shoes...
Do you have anything else? A key? Come on now, let me see!
Use the Mysterious Key near the main entrance to Tensess Temple.

Maybe this key really can help us get into the main part of Temple! If this is true... Oh, I dare not let myself believe that we can find a way out this deadlock, enter Tensess Temple, and help Voisvet!
But if the story of the Historians' betrayal is true, and I don't see a reason to doubt its validity, then this key must be for the main gate! Please check it to make sure!
Oh Great Light, please help us get into the Temple...
The Holy Tensess has heard my prayers! The way into the Temple is clear!
Find Voisvet Belov in the Heart of Tensess Temple.

Oh, I forgot the most important part! If you do manage to get inside the Temple, the first thing you should do is find Voisvet Belov! Why? Because he's the High Knight of the Church of Light, the Hero of the Great Astral Campaign, and quite possibly the leader of the entire League one day - that's why!
Now do you understand who we've got languishing away in that Temple? When you find him, tell him all you know and do whatever he asks. With him on your side I'm sure the Temple will be free of cultists in no time!
Were you able to enter the Temple?

Astral take me! What took so long?! Why was it so difficult to figure out that the Historians are the biggest scumbags in this whole story, that they're in cahoots with the cultists, that they're... ugh! I'm so mad!
Well, what are you waiting for? Tell me what in the world is going on!
Find Vissarion Arhivin in Tensess Temple.

You need to meet with Vissarion Arhivin, the Chairman of the Historians, at once! We don't know what other surprises the Empire might have in store for us. What if they assassinate him in the Temple and then lay the blame on us! Or perhaps Nefer Ur will find him first and win him over to their side with his lies and deceit. Whatever the case may be, the sooner you meet Chairman Arhivin, the better.
The main Temple entrance is guarded by the Historians, but there are two other entrances. They, too, used to be guarded by the Historians' mercenaries, but there's no one there anymore.
We must use this hole in their defense to enter the Temple and seek out Arhivin. He needs to learn about the Empire's treacherous ways right away!

Voisvet Belov and Vissarion Arhivin met in this very place. They engaged in a lengthy discussion and eventually came to an agreement.
I fell behind a bit, for I spotted an ancient structure and wanted to take a closer look. I also thought it would be wise to not intrude on their discussion.
Then Vissarion and Voisvet started through this hallway and at that very moment, a magical barrier appeared behind them, cutting me off from the rest of the party. I tried to break through the barrier, but nothing worked! So I was forced to stay behind.
Kill Rama the Cruel and inform the Mousetrapper Family.

Thank Tensess! I was certain that my hour had come... My comrades and I were escorting Voisvet Belov, the High Knight of the Church of Light, to the heart of the Temple. The Historians' mercenaries were hot on our trail, so several of us volunteered to stay behind and hold them off.
We fought like lions, but a few mercenaries still managed to break through our ranks and continued after Voisvet. I'm especially worried about Rama! He's a minotaur, a real monster! If you're planning on going further in, you better be ready for a tough fight.
Is Rama near? We could hear his terrible roar a minute ago. What a dreadful beast!

Wow, only a true hero could be capable of defeating Rama! That beast is worse than any rabid dog! He should be locked up in a zoo, not put on a payroll! When he started roaring and dragging those horns across the walls with sparks flying everywhere, we thought that we were done for!
Find Voisvet Belov, the High Knight of the Church of Light.

We were in Voisvet's party and as soon as we entered this room a group of cultists jumped out at us and a struggle broke out!
No one knows how they got here or what they want. Voisvet ordered us to return to camp and report on all this. But on the way back we were ambushed by the Historians' mercenary squad. We tried telling them about the cultists, but look at what it got us!
What are w going to do? We've got orders to complete!
Oh, but don't worry about us, you should look go on in and find Voisvet - he might need your help!

Voisvet's final order came from the other side of this magical barrier. He said that we must inform the League ambassador that cultists have infiltrated Tensess Temple and that we must learn how they got there and what they are planning!
Later, we found a group of cultists not far from here and was able to captured one prisoner. But, unfortunately, he swallowed some sort of poison before we had the chance to question him. The rest absconded into the Temple depths. And something tells me that there are plenty more of them in there!
Speak with Klavdius Trojanov about all the information obtained from Horatio de Desirae.

I must learn the nature of this magical barrier and whether it can be broken or perhaps disabled.
While I do that, you should go speak with your ambassador and tell him that the conflict between the League and the Empire has been settled.
That we need to pool our forces together in the fight against the cult! This is the will of Voisvet Belov and Vissarion Arhivin!

We've managed to remain on the Historians' good side, that's some damn good news!
Now we must turn our attention to those demon worshippers. It would've been nice to put those scoundrels out of their misery ages ago, but we were too engrossed in our war with the Empire.
And now this is the result - cultists in Tensess Temple! And us with zero information on either their numbers or the tools at their disposal. What a mess!
Meet Stas Gorlanov, League Commander at Asee-Teph.

It's good that you're here. The League needs more people like you to help in the Holy Land. You see, the Holy Land is a truly wondrous allod that was discovered in the year 1008. This ancient land was once home to the June, and after their demise it became home to the Zem.
It is also where Tep himself built a colossal pyramid ages ago. After the final battle of the Great Astral Campaign, this pyramid became home to the soul of Tensess, the Great Kanian Mage. After that the pyramid became known as Tensess Temple, and it is from there that all of the world's holy magic originates.
The Empire seeks to capture the Temple and take control of the world's holy magic. That would drain the power from all of the League's priests and paladins. Even worse, it would deprive us of the ability to be reborn after death.
For years now we've been warring with the Empire in the Holy Land. And though our cause is just, victory is a long ways off. This is why I want to ask you to head over there. I'm certain that your exceptional abilities in battle will be put to good use! Now head on over to the Novograd Port where the overseer will direct you to a ship to the Holy Land.
The ship to the Holy Land leaves from the dock to the south. I hear the Holy Land is full of mystery. They say it's full of ancient June ruins and all sorts of powerful beasts. Good luck out there!
Obtain permission for Voisvet Belov to visit Tensess Temple from the Historian Nomarkh Taltal and report back to Commander Stas Gorlanov.

You're just the man I'm looking for. I have an urgent task for you.
Voisvet Belov, the League's most glorious knight, wishes to visit Tensess Temple in order to receive a blessing from Tensess' Soul. However, according to the current agreement, access to the Temple is controlled by the Historians, which means that we must first obtain a proper permission from one of them. Damn bureaucrats!
One of the Historians in charge is Nomarkh Taltal, who's currently overseeing excavation works in the northeastern region of Asee-Teph. We need you to go to him, assist him with whatever he needs, gain his favor, and then ask about the permission.
But don't delay! It has come to our attention that the Empire is also requesting access to the Temple for one of their Great Mages, Nefer Ur. It is imperative that we get there first.
Did Nomarkh Taltal give you permission? Can I tell Voisvet you were successful?

I don't know how you did it, but this is outstanding work! I only hope the other Historians will be as compliant as Nomarkh Taltal. Voisvet will surely enter Tensess Temple before Nefer Ur. I trust you understand that this isn't just a matter of prestige!
Infiltrate the June Stronghold on the eastern side and activate the artifact and report back to Commander Stas Gorlanov in the Central League Camp upon completion.

The June Stronghold lies on the eastern front. It's nothing but ruins nowadays, but the golems therein are still well intact.
They are magical warriors that fight on the side of whoever controls the ancient June artifact at the center of the ruins. Not too long ago the Empire deployed a number of elite units into that region.
We've moved up our own forces in response, and both sides have been engaged in intense battles ever since. The control over the golem warriors keeps shifting from one side to another and back again. It's like a game of leapfrog!
You must infiltrate the bastion and put an end to this freak show. If there's anyone capable of getting this done, it's you!
Are those blasted golems still fighting on the side of the Empire? Then what you are still doing here?!
The artifact is now under our control! Outstanding work! The golems are mowing down Imperial troops left and right. Let's hope they keep it up! Bless those June and their inventive minds!
Disrupt the Demon Worshippers' ritual at the Site of Power by killing 4 Darksoul Mentalists, Drakaz the Crazed, and stealing the Demon's Heart. Report back to Archmage Esther de Desirae.

Then again, it might be too early to send a report just yet...
Various sources claim to have seen these same cultists at the Site of Power in the eastern part of Asee-Teph, close to the June Stronghold. I didn't think those reports were significant at the time, but because of the events that happened on the Overcharged Shore...
Could it be that they're attempting to conduct their ritual and desecrate the Site of Power? If so, we must stop them! And use the opportunity to gather reliable information... Phew, to think, I was this close to reporting unverified intelligence to the brass in Novograd!
So, have our suspicions been confirmed?

Then I did the right thing by delaying my report. I can only imagine what would happen on Kania if a demon showed up!
Heads would roll, believe you me!
Take the Demon Heart to Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp.

The cultists' ritual was disrupted! It turns out that their summoned demon was not quite as dangerous as one might have expected.
Perhaps because it was premature. But still, a demon is a demon... Its heart must be brought to Esther de Desirae. It's about time for her to do something useful around here!
What's that you got for me?
Ugh, again... I can barely look at the first one without puking, and now you're bringing me another one?!
Kill 6 Misty Hyenas and report back to Boris Surkov in Asee-Teph.

Are you all right? All in one piece? That's good. We have enough wounded soldiers as it is! The recruits are going into battle, dying, and resurrecting without an arm or a leg or whatever else might have been torn off. Imagine the horror!
It's all because of those blasted hyenas. The battle for the June Stronghold is growing more vicious every day, and it seems like all of Asee-Teph's hyenas have migrated to its vicinity.
The hyenas are prowling the battlefield, feasting on the dead and the wounded. We can't go on like this much longer and the Empire won't give it up without a fight. So, we only have one choice... the scavengers must be eradicated!
Not long ago there was a whole family of Gibberlings that died on the battlefield. Only two of them ever resurrected... The third was devoured by the hyenas. Those poor, hapless souls...
Don't say anything! I see you're exhausted from dealing with those hyenas, and I can smell their dying breaths on you. You've done a good deed, one which has saved countless lives!
Treat 6 Wounded League Soldiers and report back to Marielle de Pluie in Asee-Teph.

In all the battles I've been a part of in the Holy Land, I have never seen so many wounded as in the struggle for the June Stronghold! My back aches and my wings are starting to crumple from all the soldiers I've had to carry off the battlefield!
It's all because we're fighting the war on several fronts. Besides the Imperial troops, we've got those merciless golems and the terrible wounds they inflict. And then there are those hyenas that tear our fallen brethren to shreds.
Lend us a hand! I'm completely exhausted, but there are still so many wounded bodies out there. They must be carried off the battlefield, patched up, cheered up, and sent back into battle. Take my stretcher, you'll need it to complete this rescue mission.

Back when war was a more gallant affair, the two sides would call a period of truce to allow the dead and wounded to be carried off the battlefield. Those days are now gone, along with this gracious tradition. What has this world come to?
Yours is a noble heart. I don't have to tell you what a rarity it is these days! Thank you!
Obtain three Crates of Imperial Missiles for Commander Stas Gorlanov at the Central League Camp.

In order to complete your next task you'll be heading to the southeast part of Asee-Teph. There you'll find the Storehouse Complex on the Southern Shore, or SCOSS for short.
Is it any surprise that these Imperial suckers can't even come up with a decent name? One could go mad from all those stupid abbreviations! Anyway, that's where the Empire keeps their arms, ammo, and various other supplies. Naturally, they keep it under constant and heavy guard.
However, our intelligence service managed to crack a captured Imperial officer, who shared some very interesting information with us. According to the prisoner, there's a shipment of experimental missiles on its way to the storehouse. The missiles were developed by... Wait for it... The ZIT! Just when you thought they couldn't mangle our language any worse, they go and surprise you! Still, behind those senseless words there's a place where the brightest minds of the Empire are hard at work. And so it is of utmost importance that those missiles are stolen and studied by our brightest minds!
Go to the storehouse and bring back three boxes of the missiles.
Where are those Imperial missiles? I realize that they're well guarded, but you'll find a way, I'm sure of it!

Ah, here they are! You've done well! The more I work with you, the more you impress me!
We'll be shipping these boxes to Novograd. Our armories will copy their missiles or think of a way to improve them!
Meet with Sargadak the Patient and oversee the shipment of the boxes with the League literature.

Praise Tensess for answering my prayers! You're here and ready to help me again! It's about the Free Traders. Those rogues refuse to work for the Church free of charge, imagine that! Their ravenous greed is preventing them from attaining the Light!
Unfortunately, we need to employ their services.
The Free Traders are allowed to travel to all Imperial allods, a perk that we'll exploit to transport our propaganda literature into enemy territory. Brilliant and simple! Still, I don't trust those greedy characters, And that's why I want to ask you to oversee the shipment of the brochures. You'll find Sargadak, the goblin Trader, down by the southeast shore, not far from the Imperial warehouse. The boxes with our literature will be there as well. Please make sure the shipment goes off without a hitch.

The priest doesn't trust me?
Hah! Don't worry, this isn't the Church, you're safe here! I'm the most honest goblin on this allod! I mean, do I look like a crook? Everything will be just fine, believe it!
Watch, we'll load up your papers and transport them to the Empire, no problem. You have my word as a Free Trader!
Kill 6 Imperial Patrollers for Sargadak the Patient.

Although... There is one thing that you can help me with...
See, there are Imperial patrols that make their rounds up and down the coast. Enemies of the free trade, that's what they are! Whatever contraband they see, they snatch right on the spot! And if they find your fliers, those bastards will Brutal Throw me into the Astral, judge and jury be damned! They can't even be bribed!
I need you to neutralize the patrols before I can deliver your goods.
What's happening with those patrols? I ain't about to stick my neck out for nothing! The moment they show up I'm hurling your boxes into the Astral and getting rid of all evidence!
The patrols are dead? Splendid! Let me finish loading and I'll be on my merry way. You can assure the Church of Light that their shipment will reach the Empire territory in pristine condition!
Report to Stas Gorlanov upon completion of quests "Permission for Voisvet Belov," "Imperial Science" and "June Golems."

Victory is near!
You have three important quests left: "Permission for Voisvet Belov," "Imperial Science" and "June Golems."
I will wait for you eagerly. I hope that you will soon bring news of victory!
Did you complete the three quests from the fourth and final phase?

Victory!
The enemy is thwarted, crushed, terrified! This is so much more than I ever expected.
Thank you. As long as the League has people like you... There's nothing and no one we should fear!
Use the Treant Guard's Capsule near the Central Imperial Camp.

At last, the time has come to take decisive measures. We shall drive a stake right through the heart of the enemy!
I believe you're already familiar with this type of capsule. Except this time we're not using Elemental Guards. We've got something even better!
Place this capsule at the Site of Power in the Central Imperial Camp, Those Imperial jerks will be all over it and when the attack it, a mighty and invincible Treant Guard will jump out! Yes, yes, you heard me! Once, many centuries ago, Kanian druids were able to reach an understanding of sorts with the Elven archmages. And you're about to see the fruit of their collaboration in action!
Well? Did you summon the Treant to bash in those Imperial skulls?

Now let's just hope the Treant holds out as long as possible.
With allies like that it won't be long until this entire Imperial ant hill is driven to utter chaos! It's a pity I can't just forget everything and rush into battle.
But no, this is where I'm needed.
Relay the order to the Prophetic Family and report back to Gorislav Kovchegov.

So it begins. Gorlanov has issued an order to go on the offensive. It won't be long now before the Imperial heathens are driven from the Holy Land once and for all!
Of course, nothing happens by itself. We'll need to assist with this noble effort. The Church of Light will not be left on the sidelines!
We've trained another team of Gibberling seers. Their abilities were tested in the field and yielded terrific results. It has been decided to give this undertaking a name, and I know just what to call it - "The Voice of Truth!" Well, do you like it? It's right on the money, if you ask me.
Anyway, the Voice of Truth has already been deployed to the Central Imperial Camp. The seers' task is to weaken the resolve of Imperial troops and force them to Brutal Throw their weapons aside. In so doing we will assist our own troops in executing a successful offensive.
Your job is to find the Gibberlings and relay to them the order to commence the offensive!
May the truth hail upon the heads of Imperial soldiers!

I trust that the Voice of Truth is already heralding the word of the Church of Light to the misguided sheep of the Empire? I will not stand for any delays! I personally gave Commander Gorlanov my word that our seers will work over the Imperial troops before we launch the offensive.

Wonderful! Mental impressions are by far the most humane type of warfare. Imperial soldiers will simply lose their will to fight and begin to surrender voluntarily. At least that's what I'm hoping for!
In doing so, we'll minimize the needless casualties! I have faith in the Gibberlings - they'll come through for us. You know what they say - three heads are better than one!
Capture the Imperial command bunker and kill 6 Imperial Corporals and their Commander, Maxim Reznikov. Report back to Stas Gorlanov in the Central League Camp.

I've just issued the order to commence an all-out offensive on the Central Imperial Camp. Hundreds of League militia and veterans are on their way south to put an end to the Imperial presence on Asee-Teph.
But for you I've saved a special mission.
Between the Central Imperial Camp and Tensess Temple lays a fortified bunker. It is a crucial strategic point, since the Imperial forces use the bunker to monitor their surroundings. Your task is to capture this bunker and kill Maxim Reznikov, the Imperial Colonel who heads up the garrison.
Be aware that this is a very dangerous foe. He's a veteran of the Great Astral Campaign and a living legend among the Imperial troops. In the event of his death, enemy forces will be greatly demoralized and that will help our troops to achieve their goal.
Is the bunker ours? Is Maxim Reznikov dead? Make haste, we cannot afford delays!

Alright, so we have the command bunker, Reznikov is dead, and the Imperial troops are stricken with panic.
The hour of victory is near!
Use the Blessed Scroll to bless 6 recruits and return to Gorislav Kovchegov.

Wow, I don't believe my eyes! It's you!
How lucky for all of us! Tales of your heroic feats have been told across all the allods. Even here!
Your help will be truly invaluable. We've been fighting these Imperial heretics day and night with no victory in sight! It's like Sarnaut itself is drenched in heresy. Just take the name of this region - "Asee-Teph." Do you know what it means? "Tep's Grave," that's what! The horror! This land is home to the holiest of places, Tensess Temple, and it's named after a twisted Zem necromancer! And that sort of thing is everywhere!
That's why your arrival and aid are so welcome. Now I'm certain we'll be able to turn these cursed jungles into a true Holy Land after all!
We'll begin with a simple task. Assist me with blessing the new recruits! I can't handle all of them by myself. I'll give you some scrolls - use them to bless six League recruits. A blessing from you will multiply their strength and resolve by ten!
Please, help me bless the recruits. I haven't had a wink of sleep in more than twenty-four hours, but it's unacceptable to send them off into battle without a blessing!
Excellent! We're pursuing a lot of important goals here, and I'm counting on your help to achieve them. May Tensess give us strength and keep our spirits high!
Visit the Site of Power in the Central League Camp and return to Mapla Joyova.

You haven't visited a Site of Power yet? This must to be corrected right away! Every arrival must visit these sacred sites of holy magic, be they a veteran or some wet-behind-the-ears recruit. The Holy Land must accept you, recognize you, and grant you strength. How else do you expect to do battle here?
Now, listen up. At the center of the Holy Land stands Tensess Temple, formerly one of Tep's pyramids. It has recently become inhabited by the soul of Tensess. His soul radiates holy magic which permeates the entire allod through and through.
There are places in the Holy Land where this magic escapes through the ground in a giant stream of energy. These are the Sites of Power and they are spread throughout the allod.
One of them just happens to be located right here in our camp. Go over there and bathe in its power! It will strengthen your spirit for all the trials ahead!

Tensess' soul possesses colossal power. In addition to providing all of the world's holy magic, it keeps the allod from being consumed by the Astral. That is how the Holy Land survives without a Great Mage!

Have you visited the Site of Power? Great, now I can fill you in on more of the details.
Those who control the Sites of Power control their holy magic. A third of the Sites are found in our territory, a third are found in the Imperial territory, and the final third are scattered across the front lines.
We've been engaged in a continuous struggle with the Imperial forces for some time now, but we haven't been able to capture any more Sites of Power yet. However, with your help I know that we'll make more progress!
Capture the neutral and Imperial Sites of Power and report back to Esther de Desirae in the Central League Camp.

Do you remember what I told you about the Sites of Power that exist all throughout the Holy Land?
And that we only hold one third of the sites? Well, now it's time that we assert our power! We've got to show the Empire that this land is our Holy Land! That this is the will of Tensess!
Go capture all the neutral and Imperial Sites of Power. That will show the Empire.
What are you waiting for? This is our chance!
You did it? This is great! We've totally crippled them!
Meet with Mikhail Selyaninov at Maddox Depot on the northern coast of Eljune. Tell him about the demons and cultists that have been found in the Holy Land.

Oh, what are we going to do? I don't want my men panicking for no reason, but we need to get to the bottom of this. Ugh, why couldn't these cultists and demons wait until after I retire?
This calls for an expert opinion. We could always call in the hunters... But certain parties won't be happy with that at all...
So here's what we'll do. Go to Eljune, that's the territory west of Asee-Teph. Along the northern coast there's a League outpost, headed by Mikhail Selyaninov.
He's an old soldier - he even lived through the Great Astral Campaign itself. If there's a demon expert in our ranks, it's him. So let's let him deal with this... With your help, of course.

Look who finally decided to join us! What took you so damn long? Do you have any idea how many reports I've had to send, asking for reinforcements?!
Why you're out sun tanning, we're on our last leg here, fighting off the demons! Don't talk back to me! You're from Asee-Teph, you have no idea what it's like over here on the real frontlines!
Meet with Klavdius Trojanov at the League outpost near Tensess Temple.

Our situation has taken a sudden and unexpected turn for the worse. It began when the Historians refused both Voisvet and Nefer Ur's entry into Tensess Temple.
Befitting of a true empire of evil, the Empire refused to accept the Historians' decision - when nighttime fell, Imperial troops stormed the mercenaries and broke through their ranks. Nefer Ur broke into Tensess Temple! Naturally, Voisvet was forced to follow him lest the Empire seize complete control of the Temple.
Now the Historians want to break off the agreement between us and the Empire. This would lead to an all-out battle for Tensess Temple, something that we cannot allow!
The Empire has been itching for an excuse to do just that! For years they've been dreaming of stripping us of Tensess' Gift. Imagine getting killed tomorrow... only to find out that you'll never be brought back to life! Never!
We must patch up our relationship with the Historians as soon as possible! We need to get their permission to send in a rescue team to retrieve Voisvet. Our ambassador is already waiting by Tensess Temple. Consider yourself at his complete disposal!

Listen, I need your help! We're in a very delicate situation. The Historians have cut off all negotiations! It's probably best to avoid their base for now - their mercenaries are pissed off about the nighttime attack by Imperial forces.
We called in our elite troops, the League Defenders, just in case the Empire tries to exploit the turmoil and capture the Temple. They've shown that they're capable of anything. Our primary objective is to convince the Historians of our innocence!
Kill 6 League Sentinels. Report back to Klavdius Trojanov in Tensess Temple.

Those Imperial heathens are trying convince the Historians that the attack on the Temple was orchestrated by us. To make matters worse, they're taking in their troops into the Temple. And not just the green recruits, but the best they've got to offer - the Sentinels.
The situation in there is extremely volatile and could erupt any second. We must take precautions.
Kill at least 6 Imperial Sentinels. This will ensure our advantage in the event of a conflict.

The Sentinels are loyal and weathered Imperial dogs. They will fight to the last drop of blood.
Which means we must neutralize them before the conflict begins!

From here on out it's us who's got the upper hand. Should a struggle break out, our League Defenders will rout the Imperial soldiers with ease and Tensess Temple will be ours!
The Empire understands the reality of the situation - I'm certain that they will seek to resolve it peacefully.
Rescue the captive Elven Historian from the Imperial Camp near Tensess Temple.

We must preserve the peace with the Historians at any cost! We must prove to them that it was the Empire that raided their base that night! And I know just how to do it!
Just south of the Temple the Imperial troops are holding one of the Historians, an Elven female, captive. Our intelligence reports that they've been torturing her to speak out in the Empire's interests!
You must go in and rescue her! But be careful, she is sure to be under heavy guard.

At last! I was beginning to think I wouldn't make it out of here. You wouldn't believe the perverted fantasies of some of these Imperial executioners!
The Imperial troops stormed the camp at night and massacred our mercenaries.
I was squatting in the bushes when it happened - those jerks wouldn't even let me finish my business, they just grabbed me and hauled me over here! Oh! How I hate them!
Escort Leonore de Delice to the Historians' base and report back to Klavdius Trojanov at the League outpost near Tensess Temple.

I don't ever want to recall the indignities those savages put me through! Quick, escort me to the Historians' base and I'll tell my colleagues what really happened! I don't expect these Imperial scumbags to let us leave without a fight, so be on your guard!
I didn't expect you to rescue the Elven woman so fast! The Historians will be very grateful.

With their wicked actions the Empire violated the agreement with the Historians! And if that weren't enough, they then tried to pin the massacre on us!
No matter, we now possess irrefutable proof of their guilt. We'll pin their backs against the wall and restore diplomatic relations with the Historians.
Travel to the Historians' base and seek out Vissarion Arhivin.

This poor captive's testimony outweighs all of the Empire's lies! Go to the Historians' base, seek out their Vissarion Arhivin, and tell him everything we now know.
It's just too bad that we're not dealing with Zayan de Desirae. Now he would've taken our plea to heart, no doubt about it. Let's just hope that this Arhivin fellow is a Historian first and a Xadaganian second.
Oh, and don't forget this white flag. If you don't carry it the mercenaries won't let you near their base!

I'm sorry but Arhivin isn't here. Can I help you with something? Ah... Well, after the night attack, Arhivin declared a state of martial law, gathered some things together, and made for Tensess Temple.
He didn't explain anything, but his final order was to break camp and not to enter into any negotiations. I think he'd prefer it if the League and the Empire to sort this mess out amongst themselves.
Speak with Klavdius Trojanov at the League outpost near Tensess Temple.

After hearing Leonore de Delice's story, I've no doubt that our mercenaries were attacked by Imperial soldiers.
And yet, unfortunately, I'm not authorized to make decisions on matters of this magnitude. You should seek out Vissarion Arhivin at the Temple and speak to him yourself.
But be sure to talk to your diplomat before heading out. Now that we've stopped being mediators in this conflict between the League and the Empire, only he can permit you access to the Temple.

Did the mercenaries let you through to the Historians' base? What did Arhivin say?
...Ugh! His leaving for Tensess Temple isn't good. The sooner we close the chapter on this nocturnal raid business, the better. But hey, it is what it is!
Though I wonder what Vissarion Arhivin wants in the Temple?
Use 3 Elemental Capsules and return to Stas Gorlanov.

Can't decide what to occupy yourself with? Hm, if you ask me, only a coward can't find work for himself. And that's not what you are, are you?!
Listen up. I am in command of all the League troops in these lands. That means that I've got a million issues to deal with at any given moment, starting with where to house the soldiers and ending with the burial of their decapitated corpses.
That's right - the Empire isn't here to play games. The circumstances of the war here in the Holy Land and the mechanics of Tensess' Gift mean that this is the only way to render the enemy lifeless once and for all.
However, our cause is just. That is why, sooner or later, we will emerge victorious! If a certain someone can help me out with a few crucial missions, we'll be looking at sooner rather than later.
Here's the first mission on my laundry list - capturing and occupying Misty Slope. It's a place of high elevation just west of Tensess Temple. With the advantage of higher ground on our side, we'll be able to cover the Temple surroundings with support fire.
Naturally, the Empire will do whatever it can to stop us, but we've got a few tricks up our sleeve as well! A little gift from the wise and magic-loving people, the Elves. I'll give you three capsules, each containing a guardian elemental. Use them at the Site of Power on top of Misty Slope!
Have the capsules been used yet? We must capture Misty Slope, no matter what it takes!

So the guardian elementals are in place? Beautiful! Those creatures are as tenacious as they come - they should hold out for a while. Too bad we don't have a larger supply of these capsules. They could've helped us settle a myriad of problems.
Kill 6 Imperial Soldiers or Corporals and 1 Sergeant. Report back to the Troublemaker Family at Misty Slope.

Ah, it's so nice to see you! Now who are you? What was that? Oh, don't bother answering, we won't be able to hear you. It's just so loud here! So, how's it going, what are you up to? Fighting, you say? Right, right, everyone's fighting nowadays.
What did you expect? The Empire still controls half the allod - the front line still runs east to west, splitting the allod right down the middle! Or west to east, if you look from the other side, but still down the middle!
All that's about to change. Just this past week here on Misty Slope we pushed those bastards back! It must've been no less than fifty or sixty feet, and that's just the beginning!
Actually, you got here just in time. We need to secure our victory and rile some Imperial feathers at the same time! Make for their camp to the south of here and give 'em hell!
Oh, we'll show them! Our drills are always top notch and every rookie is fully trained in close combat. The Empire better watch out! So, did you mess 'em up or what?!

What's that you say? We can't hear anything! Well, judging by your smug face, your mission is complete! Hurray for that!
This will be our strategy from here on out. Swift attacks, swifter retreats. Sting the enemy, wear him out, and piss him off! With you on our side we'll drive the Imperial invaders from the Holy Land before long!
Steal 3 samples of the Experimental Missiles and return to Ariele de Grandeur.

It’s good that you're here.
I have an important job and I can't just give it to some rookie. No, this calls for a seasoned and reliable scout. A professional soldier at least. Or a brilliant hero of the League. Like you.
Here's the thing. Initially the Empire was storming our camp on a regular basis. After suffering heavy losses they changed their strategy. Now they are using catapults to bombard us. Thankfully, we've only suffered minimal damages so far, but we have reasons to be concerned! Our scouts report that a new type of projectiles has been delivered to the Imperial camp. Something experimental, no doubt. Most likely developed by their Zem scientists. We must learn more about it. Infiltrate the Imperial camp and steal three of those new missiles.
Well, where are the new missiles? We must know of every new invention from the Imperial scientists. Otherwise we risk suffering heavy losses.

You have my gratitude! I shall study these at once.
Hm, seems that we'll need to introduce certain upgrades to our defensive structures, train our troops, and, quite naturally, invent analogous ordinance for our own catapults.
We cannot afford to lose this arms race!
Destroy 6 Spider Totems and return to the Jumping Family.

Um, excuse us, but maybe you could help us? We're animists. Our power is that of nature, the power of spirits. Since the dawn of time the Orcs have been our sworn enemy, particularly their shamans. Now it looks like that the Empire has stooped to using nature magic to their advantage. It saddens us to see the vileness of it all!
We have learned from captured Imperial soldiers that the Orcish shamans are also out of favor amongst their own tribes. All the better, we say!
Still, to mend their situation the chieftain must've sent one of their own to the front lines. Or maybe there's just one, a rogue, trying to prove to the tribes back home that the shamans can be formidable foes and allies!
Either way, some shaman stuck a whole bunch of his totems throughout all of Misty Slope. These totems seem to have driven the spider population wild, and that makes life miserable for the rest of us!
Finding the totems is easy enough. Just look for an area with the largest number of spiders, you won't miss it! And when you find them - destroy them! Everyone here would be extremely grateful.
The enemy intrigues are giving us quite a headache. Did you destroy the spider totems?
Now let's hope this will pacify the spiders. The shaman knows his craft, to be sure, but his tricks are yesterday's news! It's not surprising that their kind can't get along with one another.
Destroy 6 Large Signal Beacons and report to Stas Gorlanov.

Alright, are you ready for your next mission? Along the northern coast, just to the west of our camp, is a mine where we extract meteorite ore for our Astral ships.
It's a site of tremendous strategic importance, which explains why the Empire keeps encroaching upon it. Our scouts report that an Imperial fleet is preparing to raid the coastline. Imperial saboteurs are trying to set signal beacons at the entrance to the mine. This would mark the spot for the Imperial cannoneers.
The attack, if successful, would kill our troops and demolish our mining equipment, bringing our work to a screeching halt. Therefore, the beacons must be destroyed!
Have the beacons been destroyed? They must be taken out as soon as possible. The Imperial ships will be here any minute!
The beacons are gone and the workers may resume their work in peace. This mine is one of the largest sources of meteorite ore in all the land. Losing it would be catastrophic for the League.
Kill 6 Jungle Harpies and report back to the Coughing Family.

Hooray! The League's greatest hero has honored us with their presence! Now we'll be able to eradicate those harpies for sure!
Listen, we've got a real problem here. The jungle has been teeming with harpies lately. The nasty things are constantly attacking our miners and guards.
The other day the whole flock came swooping in and we barely made it into the mine in time. We had to spend the whole day down there, starving, while the Defenders fought them off at the entrance.
Long story short, we need to kill six Harpies! I bet it's a piece of cake for you!
Please hurry - who knows when those blasted beasts will decide to pay us another visit!
Those harpies sure are nasty customers. How many have you killed so far?
Thanks for your help! You'd think we didn't have enough problems without those vile creatures! Let's hope the harpies will think twice before bothering us again.
Find evidence about the Imperial saboteurs' hideout and return to Ruslan Demidov.

Well, what do you want? Are you here to stare at the rocks or do you wanna talk business? Help, huh? Well, we can always use a hand around here.
Listen up, there have been all kinds of accidents and equipment malfunctions recently - non-stop, one right after another!
Just the other day some blasphemous ass drew graffiti all over our Site of Power saying "Nezeb was here!" If I knew who it was, I'd rip 'em to pieces! Then again, I guess I do know... We're dealing with Imperial saboteurs. That means they're nearby somewhere, hiding... and we need to find where.
Your mission is to hunt down the saboteurs, kill them, and search their bodies for any clues. We must find the whereabouts of their hideout!
Damn these saboteurs, hiding out in the jungle! Where, oh where can they be...
Hm, let's see here... Aha! See that marker right there? I bet that's where their hideout is. We'll send out a squad right away and crush those asses for good! Excellent work!
Collect Holy Water from the Site of Power and bless the entrance to the mine and report back to the Nathanael de Blizare upon finishing.

May the Light be with you! I was granted the tremendous honor of guarding this Site of Power! This is where the concentration of magical energy is especially abundant. Sometimes it's as though I hear the voice of Tensess himself.
Just listen! Do you hear it too? Ah, that's a shame. But don't fret - such a gift is not bestowed lightly. And especially not without years of selflessness and devout service to the Light!
Speaking of which, we've got the sanctification of the mine and its surroundings on today's agenda. We conduct the ritual regularly, so as to be sure that the spirit of Tensess is always with us in our work, protecting us against vicious beasts.
Here, take this bottle. Fill it with holy water from the Site of Power, then sprinkle the water over the mine's surroundings. Perhaps then the spirit of Tensess shall be revealed to you...
Pilgrims from various League allods travel to the Holy Land to worship at our Site of Power. Here the blind have regained their sight and the disabled have walked again!

Now that the mine has been sanctified, our miners may resume their work with confidence, for the Holy Tensess shall aid them henceforth!
And what about you? Did you merit attaining the holy revelation?
That's a pity, but don't despair! Nay, go forth with renewed faith in your heart!
Obtain a Historians' Booklet for Gorislav Kovchegov.

Do you know about the Historians? They're a group of history buffs that are hell-bent on researching ancient legends and traditions. Honestly, I think all that stuff is pure nonsense. What's the point in grubbing about in the dusty past? You need to look to the future.
The Historians are also neutral to the League and the Empire - you'll find Elves, Kanians, Xadaganians, and even the Arisen among them. The Historians are headed by the Great Mage Zayan, an Elf. He wouldn't be my first choice, but then again, I'm no Historian.
Moreover, the Historians command great respect, so much so that it was they who became the mediators between us and the Empire in our... Let's call it an 'argument'... Over Tensess Temple. The upside is that according to the agreement, they control access to Tensess Temple. If it weren't for them, that holy place would've become the site of countless gory battles.
But there's also a downside - the Historians have no connection to the Church. As such they are liable to both over and underestimate the true value of the discoveries. This in turn may impede the great mission of the Church of Light.
Right now what I need are one of the Historians' brochures so that I can confirm they haven't been up to anything suspicious lately. Would you mind going down to their camp near Uskul the Dead City and getting one for me?
Did you get any documents? Any will do, even a small brochure! Hurry now, I can't wait to expose those heretical masterminds!

Well, this essentially proves that the Historians have absolutely no connection to the heresy. They are focused on studying June history and don't profess to anything more than that.
This is actually good news. I admit, I really didn't want a falling out with the Historians. We are bound by a peace treaty, after all!
Set an Enrager at the Site of Power in Uskul the Dead City and report back to Stas Gorlanov.

How are you feeling? Got enough left in you for another mission? Fantastic!
The Empire has occupied the entire southern portion of the allod, but things aren't exactly smooth sailing over there, praise Tensess. We're getting reports of trolls rioting and banshees attacking soldiers and civilians alike.
And that's actually what I wanted to talk to you about. Banshees spawn Around Uskul the Dead City that is home to a Site of Power. Naturally, the Empire keeps trying to capture it and the banshees are getting in the way. They're terribly stubborn and vicious creatures as is, but we want to make them even nastier!
Here, take this enrager - it was given to me by Elven demonologists. When placed in the vicinity of the undead, the creatures go absolutely nuts! Set the artifact at the Site of Power in Uskul the Dead City. Let those Imperial bastards feel firsthand the fury of the fallen!
Is the enrager in place? The banshees must be livid!
If the Empire wants to make use of propaganda and subversive tactics, then we'll give them a taste of their own medicine!
Report to Stas Gorlanov upon completion of quests "Key Height," "Saboteur Lighthouses" and "Rage of the Fallen."

There are lots of quests waiting for you in Asee-Teph. They are all important and necessary in their own way.
But the most important among them are the ones that I give you.
They must be completed first.
This is war! Discipline is important when executing orders, and it's high time you understood that.
So, the three important quests for the first phase are as follows: "Key Height," "Saboteur Lighthouses" and "Rage of the Fallen."
Did you complete the three quests from the first phase?
Wonderful, now we can proceed with the conquest of Asee-Teph.
Deliver orders to the commanders of the 3 Guerrilla Squads and report back to Stas Gorlanov.

For your next task, I need you to go deep into enemy territory.
A week ago the League landed a squad of paratroopers on the southern shore, close to SCSS.
Alas, the operation was a failure. The squad met strong resistance from the enemy immediately after landing. They were unable to secure a foothold on the shore and had to flee into the nearby jungle. They've been engaged in guerrilla warfare ever since.
We maintain communication with them on a regular basis, but now I'm asking you to deliver these letters with my orders to the commanders of all three squads.
Did the guerrilla commanders receive my orders? All three of them?

Thank you for your help. The job may have been simple, but that doesn't mean that it's less important. The letters contained reconnaissance information and my orders regarding future subversive operations in enemy territory.
With our help the guerrillas' actions will be more organized and thus efficient, keeping our losses to the minimum!
Collect 6 pieces of Tapir Meat for Selifan Briskov.

I don't know how the brass expects us to carry out physically taxing orders when we're starved half to death!
I sent three men out hunting the other day. They got carried away and drove a tapir right into the enemy camp. Not only did they lose the tapir but they got themselves captured as well. Meanwhile we're back here on short rations, scraping by on an all green diet.
Be a pal and go out and hunt some tapirs for us. There are plenty of 'em by the Imperial Outpost. Bring me back five pieces of their meat, alright?
Some hot soup would really hit the spot! Chunky and full of giblets! Yum...

Hurray! Now we'll be able to stuff our faces real good! We've been on an all green diet for a week now - roots, berries, herbs, and whatnot. I'm shocked we haven't started bleating yet! This vegan lifestyle just doesn't agree with me!
Steal 2 Imperial Shields, 2 Imperial Swords, and 2 suits of Imperial Armor for Rostislav Sherengov.

It's hard to believe, but we landed on this shore armed to the teeth! With brand new armor and weapons, especially commissioned for the operation.
But most of our gear was lost before we even made it into the jungle. And what we were able to save is already growing rusty from all this dampness. What are you gonna do? This is the jungle, after all!
The Empire, on the other hand, is getting their supplies restocked regularly. Just the other day the Imperial Outpost received a new shipment of blades. How about the Imperial soldiers share their new toys with us? Go into the jungle and teach the enemy the joy of sharing!
Where are the Imperial weapons? We won't get far with sticks and stones!

Look at those beauties, sparkling clean and sharp as a razor!
The Empire takes good care of their blades, that much is clear. How ironic that their precious steel will soon come crashing down on their own heads!
Kill Zinoviy Oskolkin for Kazimir Gusev.

The mission has been a complete failure... Ugh, if this keeps up I'm demoting myself to commanding goblins!
You see, we're stuck in a streak of terrible luck. The Empire has increased their security and our foray last night failed miserably as a result. I lost a third of my men.
Most of the captives were starved, tortured, and then executed. If I could, I'd kill their executioner myself, but I cannot afford to let a personal vendetta outweigh common sense...
Your mission is to assassinate Zinoviy Oskolkin, the commander of the Imperial Outpost. That monster enjoys executions - he actually prefers to do the beheading himself!
We must avenge our fallen brothers! The bastard needs to die! Help justice prevail by helping us! You can do it - I know you can!
I need some good news! Tell me that Oskolkin has been executed! I have a personal score to settle with that bastard.
Good... For as long as I live, I will work to make sure that no Imperial scum ever feels safe in the Holy Land again! I swear it!
Kill General Yuri Aksakov, steal the Imperial Manuscript, and deliver it to Gorislav Kovchegov.

Well, we can't accuse the Historians of anything. The Empire, however... Do you know what the main ideological difference between the Church of Light and the Trinity Church is? Well...? Oh, come on... The names give it away!
It's that the Imperial priests proclaimed Nezeb and Skrakan saints! Those two are equal to Tensess! Not to take away from Skrakan's many accomplishments... And sure, Nezeb was a true Great Mage, but what does either of them have to do with the Light?!
That's pure blasphemy and it goes against our entire doctrine! What's stopping them from promoting Yasker to saint status?!
Rumor has it that a new Catechism of the Trinity Church is about to go into print. I shudder to think the impieties it contains... You'll find one of the authors, General Yuri Aksakov, at the Central Imperial Camp. Kill him and steal that manuscript! I'm sure that you can complete this feat in the name of the one true Church!
Yuri Aksakov is a wicked heretic who insults the very foundation of our faith! Did you kill him? Where's the manuscript?

Let's take a look at the new Catechism of the Trinity Church... Damnation! This thing is filled with terrible heresy through and through, I can't even read it without shuddering!
Two can play this game! The Elves, our allies, have long since been proficient in efforts to enlighten the Imperial heathens - and with considerable success, I might add. Now their efforts are overseen and coordinated by the Church of Light.
Sooner or later we will convert those heretical sheep... Oh, what I meant to say was... those misguided sheep! But listen, this information is still top secret, so let's keep it between us. Remember, enemy spies are nearer than you think!
Rescue 3 prisoners and report back to Kazimir Gusev.

We've just received terrible tidings! The Empire is about to execute several captured guerrillas! We must rescue them! It is our sacred duty!
The executions are set to take place at the Site of Power in the Imperial Outpost. Rescue our boys, slaughter the guards, and destroy the scaffold that is washed in the blood of dozens of fellow guerrillas! Remember that time is of the essence, so you'll need to act and act fast!
Make haste, we must rescue our friends. Every second wasted may cost them their lives!

I thank you from the bottom of my heart. The lives of my soldiers were hanging by a thread and if it weren't for your swift and valiant actions, they never would have made it!
The rescued guerrillas are fired up and aching to rush back into battle! Soon we will strike a serious blow to the Imperial Outpost! May Tensess be with us!
Find a clue related to the Predator in the Tekyan Thicket.

Listen to me carefully.
The front line runs just east of Tensess Temple and through the Tekyan Thicket, which translates to "Predatory Thicket" in the June language.
The situation there is extremely difficult. Dense jungle and deadly fauna make war even harder than it normally is, especially for new recruits. And then there are the reports of a new monster that leaps out from the thicket, slaughters several soldiers at once, and vanishes. And it doesn't discriminate - it kills Imperial soldiers just as readily as ours. The troops dubbed the beast the "Predator!"
I am asking you to track down this Predator and kill it. Can you handle that?
I'd suggest you start your search near the League Outpost, east of the thicket.
The Gibberling appears to have gigantic bite marks all over its body. These can't have been made from the teeth of normal jungle creatures. This must have been the work of the fabled Predator!
Kill 6 Jungle Tigers for the Squabbling Family.

The thicket has been teeming with tigers lately! And those damn cats have taken a liking to munching on the soldiers from our camp. That's right - they're man-eaters now!
The three of us dug a trench to trap them, but those cunning beasts just walked around it. But then the Commander fell right in and nearly got us a lashing. We don't know what else to do...
Help us thin the tigers' numbers some, before they turn our entire camp into their cafeteria.
Don't hang us out to dry! Please exterminate the tigers before they drag every last one of our soldiers into the jungle!

Thanks! Now we can resume our service in peace.
Hopefully the remaining lions and tigers will get scared and run off deep into the jungle. That's what we would've done!
Escort the Ravenous Mite to the Site of Power and return to Miroslava Rostkova.

Our commander has been sent away to rehabilitate his broken leg. The poor guy! But then again, we're the ones who had to stay behind... We've received orders to seize control over the Site of Power in Tekyan Thicket before the Empire gets their troops to it.
The problem is that the jungle is damn near impenetrable, and without magic we're pretty much doomed to fail! That's why I decided to take matters into my own hands! I am a druid and I saw an opportunity to apply some of my knowledge.
I'm going to summon a mite that will eat all nearby plants, blazing a trail to the Site of Power. However, I need a guard to escort it and protect it from predators and enemy soldiers. It also needs to be fed dried branches along the way - it loves dried branches and it'll hold its attention. Now go escort the mite!
Hey now, don't leave that mite without supervision. He's very vulnerable and might die without ever reaching his destination!

I knew the mite wouldn't let us down! Now the road to the Site of Power is clear! I don't do what I do for the sake of glory, but I will certainly petition for some kind of medal for this. Maybe they'll even invent a new medal in honor of our heroic feats! Medal of the Beetle... I like that name!
Take the Predator's Heart to Esther de Desirae.

This heart must be delivered to Esther de Desirae at the Central League Camp.
Tell her that this demon may not be alone out there. Something wicked is afoot in the Holy Land, so we had better be on our guard.
Demon Hunters? What could they possibly want in this jungle?

Why, that's a demon heart! Hm... Well, at least it's dead and won't hurt anyone anymore.
But Alexey Luzhin is right - this whole situation is very bizarre. I mean, for a demon to live outside of the Astral for so long and still be so full of life... Strong enough to be slaying soldiers left and right. Aye, I fear there may be grave times ahead!
Deliver 6 pieces of propaganda material to the League Missionaries near Kotick the Dead City. Report back to Stas Gorlanov in the Central League Camp.

Your next mission will probably sound incredibly easy to you. And that's probably the case, considering your past exploits. Oh well, think of it as a vacation of sorts.
I'll start with the good news - we have finally found allies in the Holy Land! I'm talking about lamias - brave and beautiful lady warriors! The bad news is that their arrogance, haughtiness, and capriciousness is on par with their valor and beauty!
So we've have to always keep them engaged, lest they decide to run over to the other side out of sheer boredom. At this moment, there is a team of League missionaries working at the Lamia settlement by Kotick, the Dead City. We've just received a new shipment of propaganda materials from Kania and we need to get it into their hands before their supplies run out.
Did the missionaries get their propaganda leaflets? Are they satisfied?

I'm confident that our propaganda efforts in the Lamia settlement are not going to waste.
But then again, something tells me that it would've been far easier to gain their trust with fashion magazines or weapons catalogs!
Alas, the Church of Light subscribes to a differing view.
Report to Stas Gorlanov upon completion of quests "Light Reading for Lamias", "Orders for Guerrillas", and "The Predator."

The next three quests will take you to Tekyan Thicket, Kotick the Dead City and the Imperial Outpost.
I'm talking about the following quests: "Light Reading for Lamias", "Orders for Guerrillas" and "The Predator."
Complete these quests and we'll be able to move on to the third phase.
Did you complete the three quests from the second phase?
Wonderful, now we can proceed with the conquest of Asee-Teph.
Investigate what happened at the League Outpost on the Overcharged Shore.

Our scouts' reports give every indication to believe that the Empire is planning another dirty trick. New troops are being pulled into Asee-Teph, the enemy is regrouping. We don't have any information about specific numbers or plans, so the only thing we can do is look for glaring holes in our defenses. And one of such hole is clearly visible with the naked eye.
To the northwest of here lies the Overcharged Shore, home to one of the League's weakest outposts. And if we allow the Empire to take that region, we'll be putting our entire western front at risk, only the Jungle Mine will separate us from the enemy. And, of course, that's not a place that we want to turn into a battlefield.
Our concerns are amplified by the fact that we haven't received any reports from the Overcharged Shore for several days now. And the last courier we sent out there hasn't returned.
I've got a bad feeling about this, which is all the more reason why this matters needs immediate investigation. You are the only one I can trust with this mission.

Cultists? Where did they come from? Hm, I've heard stories of certain allods still harboring traces of the cult that arose after the demon invasion. I'd wager that these fanatics are somehow connected to it. The real question is, what are they doing here?
What terrible timing! We need to deploy a new brigade at once! If the Empire finds out that we lost the outpost, we'll be in serious trouble!
Report on what took place on the Overcharged Shore to Esther de Desirae, Archmage of the League Defenders, in the Central League Camp.

It didn't work! I can't purify the Site of Power by myself...
Where did they come from and what are they doing here?!
This is all very alarming. Why, just a few days ago, I was certain that demons were a thing of the long gone past. But now... Now I have my doubts.
Go to the Central League Camp and seek out Esther de Desirae. Since she's the Archmage of the Defenders, she will recognize the significance of this distressing new data. After all, the Defenders were formed to be both a shield for the League and a retributive sword in the fight against demons. Perhaps it is time for them to remember their true calling!

Cultists?! Hm, that's very strange... I didn't take part in the Great Astral Campaign, but I know that closing the June gates is what stopped the demon invasion. The cultists scattered like dust in the wind after that, having lost the very foundation of their terrible prophecies. Now they've wound up here...
I don't know what to do about this. What we need is good advice. I suppose I should send a report to Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd. Let him figure it out.
